events.subject: Try one real workflow for free
events.preview_text: Build a customer intake form or survey before deciding if Tally fits.
events.body:
Start with one customer-facing intake or survey—the kind of real workflow that tells you more than a product tour. You can build it before deciding whether Tally suits the job.

Tally is an online form builder where you create a form by typing questions as you would in a document. That gives you a concrete way to test the building experience on work that matters.

And the free plan does not stop at that first form. It includes unlimited forms and unlimited submissions as long as your usage stays within Tally’s fair usage guidelines—so separate intake and survey workflows can each have their own form.

The first decision is simply which workflow to try.

Request: Write exactly one email. Introduce our product to a new buyer with one clear next step.
Delivered 1 of 1 email(s). Average simulated reader's interest (uncalibrated) 6.0/10.
- Email 1 "Try one real workflow for free": Tally gives the reader room to create forms for each intake or survey workflow and collect submissions without free-plan form or submission caps, within fair usage guidelines. - pull 6/10 - still below the 7/10 floor after 1 rewrite(s)
Email(s) 1 did not satisfy the simulated assessment criteria. The loop stopped rewriting them; it did not decide these were ready to send.
What held the copy back: Some linked source pages could not be read; the corpus is partial: https://tally.so/ - Use only the readable captured facts; do not infer missing prices, features or proof.
What would help most next time: Resolve this simulated next-step obstacle: I would have clicked if this email had told me roughly how long it takes to recreate a typical customer intake form and whether I can invite a teammate to test it on the free plan. Check existing verified material first; surface a supported answer or documentation link appropriate to the CTA. If absent, obtain this specific information. Reader expectations are not product evidence.
Effective audience: Operations/customer success lead at a fast-growing company
